digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and packaged guide authoring documentation
propositions: The packaged plan authoring guide must document that risky mechanisms whose correctness resolves only after a slow codified delivery loop (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning) must be de-risked out-of-loop with a concrete fast proof before committing to the loop.
The guide must identify this de-risk-before-slow-loop behavior as criterion T15 and enumerate the two permitted fast proof forms: a local run or a manual probe against the real target.
The guide must state that throwaway experiments are cleaned up with teardown scoped only to resources created by the experiment, and must remain stack-agnostic without product-specific references.
The hand-authored plan-review-gate documentation must be updated from the stale T1–T12 enumeration to T1–T15 and aligned with the validated criterion count from registry validation.
The generated criterion-pins manifest must be regenerated to include the T15 pin for the updated packaged guide.
The `rebar explain plan` command must render the updated guidance including T15 identification, local-or-manual proof forms, and scoped-cleanup boundaries through the explain_guide surface.
